blocks.heading: Healthcare (Spokane's Primary AI Market)
paragraphs: Spokane is the healthcare hub of the Inland Northwest — serving eastern Washington, northern Idaho, and western Montana:

Providence Health System Spokane: Providence's Spokane market includes Sacred Heart Medical Center, Holy Family Hospital, and the Inland Northwest Health Services (INHS) health information exchange. HIPAA-compliant clinical AI for Providence's Spokane regional network.
MultiCare Health System: MultiCare's Deaconess and Valley Hospital in Spokane. Clinical AI with Washington My Health MY Data Act compliance.
Washington State University Health Sciences Spokane (WSU Elson S. Floyd College of Medicine): WSU's Spokane medical school creates clinical research AI demand for Eastern Washington.
Cost: $45,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Agriculture (Eastern Washington's Agricultural Economy)
paragraphs: Eastern Washington produces an extraordinary variety of high-value agricultural products:

Winter wheat: Eastern Washington is one of the US's leading winter wheat producing regions. Wheat variety performance prediction, disease resistance analytics, and yield prediction from weather and soil data.
Tree fruit: Washington State is the US's largest apple producer. Precision orchard management AI from drone imagery, harvest timing optimization, and fruit quality prediction.
Potatoes: Significant potato production in the Columbia Basin. Irrigation optimization, yield prediction, and quality analytics for Spokane's potato growing region.
Wine grapes: The Walla Walla and Columbia Valley wine regions create viticulture AI demand for Spokane's adjacent wine grape growing community.
Cost: $35,000–$95,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks

blocks.heading: Manufacturing
paragraphs: Kaiser Aluminum (Spokane-area aluminum smelting), food processing, and Spokane's manufacturing base. Predictive maintenance from manufacturing equipment sensor data.
Cost: $35,000–$95,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks
